description: Plan a migration between two SQLite or D1 databases WITHOUT applying it. Returns the migration SQL plus a blast-radius analysis: each operation classified safe / risky / destructive, with an estimated write-lock duration for table rebuilds. Use this before applying any migration to a D1 database. Read-only.

new.description: Target ('after') source with the desired schema — Database source: a local file path (./app.db), a Cloudflare D1 DSN (d1://DB_ID when CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN+CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID are set, or d1://TOKEN@ACCOUNT_ID/DB_ID), or a Turso DSN (turso://TOKEN@ORG/DB).

old.description: Current ('before') source — Database source: a local file path (./app.db), a Cloudflare D1 DSN (d1://DB_ID when CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN+CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID are set, or d1://TOKEN@ACCOUNT_ID/DB_ID), or a Turso DSN (turso://TOKEN@ORG/DB).

name: litescope_migrate_plan

destructive.description: True if any operation drops or rewrites data.

operations.description: Each operation classified safe/risky/destructive with lock estimate.

statements.description: Number of SQL statements in the plan.

title: Plan a migration (no apply)
